evidence.section: 3.2 Microstructure and phase identification of as-cast EHEAs
evidence.quote: Fig. 2 illustrates the microstructural morphology of the as-cast (CoCrFeNi)93-x(NiAl)xNb7 EHEAs at both low and high magnifications.
The (CoCrFeNi)81(NiAl)12Nb7 and (CoCrFeNi)77(NiAl)16Nb7 alloys consist of the FCC phase (comprising massive dendrites and small spheres)
a minor amount of triple-phase eutectic structure is observed at the grain boundaries
the SAED patterns taken along the [001], [1211], and [001] zone axes correspond to the FCC phase, C14-type Laves phase, and B2 phase at the grain boundaries of the NiAl-16 alloy
a minor amount of triple-phase eutectic structure is observed at the grain boundaries
Group 1: micrometer-scale FCC dendritic phase + fine eutectic organization [FCC + Laves] measuring 240 nm – 275.4 nm (NiAl-8)
fine eutectic [FCC + Laves] ranging from 237.8 nm to 286.2 nm + nanoscale eutectic [FCC + Laves + B2] (NiAl-12, NiAl-16)
Group 3: micrometer-scale FCC dendritic phase + fine eutectic organization [FCC + Laves + B2] measuring 186.5 nm – 210 nm (NiAl-19)
Group 4: micron-sized FCC dendritic phase + micron-sized coarse eutectic [FCC + B2] + fine eutectic [FCC + Laves + B2] ranging from 159.2 nm to 192 nm (NiAl-22)
Group 5: micron-sized coarse eutectic [FCC + B2] + fine eutectic [FCC + Laves + B2] measuring 155 nm – 198 nm (NiAl-26)
Group 6: micrometer-scale B2 dendritic phase + fine eutectic [FCC + Laves + B2] ranging from 165.8 nm to 205 nm (NiAl-32)
